groups.title: Hydraulic horizontal benders · value line
groups.lead: Horizontal benders for flat bar from 11 to 44 US tons — NovoTech value line, built in China.

groups.title: Universal and bench benders for flat bar and rod
groups.lead: Hand benders for flat bar, rod and light angle — gates, railings and ornamental iron.
groups.tagline: NovoTech's own brand: manufactured in China to high North American quality standards, with a 1-year warranty and parts and support from Mississauga, ON, Canada

intro_add: NovoTech's value-line HB-10T, HB-25T and HB-40T hydraulic benders, built in China, bend flat bar to 6-1/4 × 1/2″, and the UB, SBG and YP hand benders and ornamental iron tools cover flat bar, rod and light angle without power.
points_add: NovoTech value line: HB-10T / 25T / 40T hydraulic horizontal benders; UB universal benders and ornamental iron tools

related_add.label: Tube and pipe benders · value line

set.hero_brand_line: Tubend machines are made in Bursa, Turkey, by Tubend Machine, with European components; NovoTech's value-line benders are built in China to NovoTech's specification. All sold, installed and supported in Canada by NovoTech.
